title: Ratchet family file (contracts §12, 2.1-M186, 2.1-M222)
description: One file per rule family in policy/ratchets/, named <family>.json, of one of three kinds (2.1-M222): a ratchet, whose named entries or one count only shrink (or, with the ceilings header, never rise); a budget, a ceiling and a tolerance per key, failing only above the ceiling times one plus the tolerance; a floor, per-tool floors with the include and exclusion patterns they are measured over, failing below a floor. policy/check.mjs validates every family file against this schema with a validator that refuses any keyword it does not implement.

tool.description: The tool that reports this family's sites. Its adapter, policy/adapters/<tool>.mjs, turns the tool's output into the sites compare() takes; policy/check.mjs refuses a tool with no adapter, so a tool joins with its adapter and this schema lists none (2.1-M189).

select.description: The tool's rule ids this family counts; every site its tool reports when omitted.

bead.description: A ratchet family's open bead that pays down every entry without its own, or its count (canopi-f47t.52.257): the stopping rule reads each entry as empty, carrying an open bead or standing (2.1-M78). A family names a bead or standing, not both (ratchet-entry-has-bead).

ceilings.description: A ratchet family whose entries (or count) are ceilings (design check A19): a count above one still fails, a fall passes with nothing to lower. Budgets and floors are ceilings or floors by kind and take no header.

standing.description: A ratchet family whose entries without a bead stay by design, such as the cross-area edges the target counts (2.1-M238); budgets and floors are standing by kind and take neither field.

budgets.description: A budget family's keys, each a measured name (a chunk, a timing) with its ceiling and its tolerance, a fraction of the ceiling.

floors.description: A floor family's tools, each with its floors per metric (percentages) and the include and exclusion patterns, in the tool's own pattern language, it is measured over.
